definition.en: The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a high-speed, high-capacity railway network specifically designed for the exclusive movement of freight to decongest existing Indian railway lines.
definition.hi: The Dedicated Freight Corridor (DFC) is a high-speed, high-capacity railway network specifically designed for the exclusive movement of freight to decongest existing Indian railway lines.

importanceInUpsc.en: The DFC is a critical component of India's logistics infrastructure, directly impacting the cost of doing business and industrial efficiency. It is frequently examined in UPSC GS-3 under infrastructure development, economic growth, and supply chain management.
importanceInUpsc.hi: The DFC is a critical component of India's logistics infrastructure, directly impacting the cost of doing business and industrial efficiency. It is frequently examined in UPSC GS-3 under infrastructure development, economic growth, and supply chain management.

learningOutcomes.en: Understand the economic rationale behind segregating freight and passenger traffic.
learningOutcomes.hi: Understand the economic rationale behind segregating freight and passenger traffic.

learningOutcomes.en: Analyze the impact of DFC on logistics costs and industrial competitiveness.
learningOutcomes.hi: Analyze the impact of DFC on logistics costs and industrial competitiveness.
